title: The Vision of Interdisciplinary Instruction
before:
The II team's vision is to create a future where changemakers are equipped with the dispositions, conceptual understandings, skills, and knowledge necessary to tackle global challenges through interdisciplinary instruction.  The II team believes that embracing interdisciplinary pedagogies can break down the barriers between traditional academic disciplines and foster a more whole-child approach to learning.  This approach empowers the next generation of thinking and leaders to think critically, collaborate across disciplines, and innovate solutions that address the interconnected social, economic, and environmental issues facing our world today.

decisions.label: Set an over-long heading as the paragraph it is
decisions.why: 1 heading runs past 100 characters — the longest here is 651. "The II team's vision is to create a future where changem…" is body text that was set as a heading to make it stand out, so it is announced as a section of the page and, at h2, written into the contents list as a link. It becomes a paragraph. Any anchor on it is kept, so existing links still land, and not a word changes.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.
